_comment: Validation A: rainy night, village courtyard (story-driven environment)

outline.title: Barish ki raat
outline.logline: On a stormy monsoon night a grandfather calls the children in from the courtyard.

characters.name: Meera
characters.role: a curious 12-year-old girl, the youngest in the family
characters.appearance: a 12-year-old girl with dark hair and a headscarf
characters.clothing: green kurta and salwar with a maroon dupatta

characters.name: Arjun
characters.role: Meera's cheerful elder brother, a young man of twenty
characters.appearance: a young man with short black hair and a cap
characters.clothing: blue and white hoodie with jeans

characters.name: Dadaji
characters.role: their grandfather, an old man, calm and funny
characters.appearance: an old man with grey hair and a grey beard
characters.clothing: green shirt under a beige vest

locations.name: Village courtyard
locations.look: the courtyard of a village house with mud walls, a charpai and clay pots, monsoon rain
locations.lighting: a single bulb over the door in heavy rain

shots.action: Dadaji stands by the door in the rain and calls the children.

line.speaker: dadaji
line.text: बारिश बहुत तेज़ है, बच्चों। जल्दी अंदर आ जाओ।

shots.action: Meera looks at the dark sky, worried.

line.speaker: meera
line.text: दादाजी, बिजली कड़क रही है। मुझे डर लग रहा है।

shots.action: Arjun smiles and puts a hand on her shoulder.

line.speaker: arjun
line.text: डरो मत मीरा, मैं हूँ ना। चलो अंदर चलते हैं।
